reason: The potato bed needs higher lightproof sides, and the foil-backed cloth previously made its skirt.
expectation: The cloth will extend the skirt so additional growing medium can cover developing tubers.

alternatives.reason: The mesh could support the soybean stems and pods.

effect: The raised collar now has room for more medium around the potato stems.
reason: Adding growing medium inside the higher collar should keep developing tubers covered and dark.
expectation: The medium will fill the extended bed around the lower stems while leaving the leaves exposed.

alternatives.reason: The mesh may provide the soybean support needed for the other goal.

effect: The potatoes are hilled and protected from light; the soybean support remains.
reaction: The collar and medium worked as expected.
reason: Cargo mesh can form a support beside the soybean stems and filling pods.
expectation: The mesh will support the soybean plants as their pods fill.

effect: The mesh supported the soybean stems, completing the remaining goal without disturbing their roots.
reaction: It worked as expected; attaching it to the existing frame felt physically sensible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Extending the potato collar and adding medium made a clear, useful connection between keeping developing tubers dark and leaving the leaves exposed to light.

leastWorthwhile.text: The collar extension was predictable given the earlier skirt, although it was a sensible preparation for hilling.

surprise.text: Nothing was particularly surprising; the combinations worked as expected.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary: each addressed an explicitly described need.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because the practical growing-room decisions connect making things with understandable plant needs, though this chapter's combinations were straightforward.
